messages:
alex: Heads up — flying out of SFO at 6:30am tomorrow. Any 24/7 or super-early breakfast recs near the airport or SoMa? Need coffee + something handheld.

maria: If you're by the airport, Boudin in the terminal is fastest after security, but outside SFO check Millbrae Peet's (opens ~5:30) or Blue Bottle in Terminal A.

tyler: Mama's on Washington is solid for eggs but opens at 6 — might be tight. For something reliably early, try 'The Plant' in Millbrae (some days open 5:00/5:30).

clare: If you're staying SoMa, Blue Bottle (Mint Plaza) opens 6am weekdays — walkable from a few hotels. Dottie's True Blue Cafe (Mission) opens 6, but it's a 10–15 min ride.

sam: For tacos (if you end up late night), La Taqueria opens later. For a 5am-ish fix, grab a pre-order via app (Peet's or Blue Bottle) and pick up curbside to save time.

alex: I'm at the SoMa Marriott. Blue Bottle Mint Plaza sounds perfect. Any tips on fastest route to SFO from there at that hour?

tyler: Uber/Lyft drop at departures is easiest. If you want transit, T-Third to Embarcadero then BART — first trains ~5:00–5:15 so it's tight but doable.

airport-bot: heads-up: SFO parking/curbside can be slow during peak — allow +15 minutes for drop-off. :warning:

clare: Also pro-tip: buy your coffee via app so you can just swing by security with it. Avoids lines.

alex: Thanks all — ordering a cold brew and egg sandwich at 5:50 pickup. Will report back if it's life-changing. :thumbsup:

maria: Safe travels! :airplane:

sam: Post sandwich pic or it didn't happen :joy:
